Name: panel_lead
Conductors (colour · from → to): + red · Panel junction box + → PMB-H J1-1 PV_IN+ | − blue · Panel junction box − → PMB-H J1-2 PV_IN−
Source: Original panel lead (measured from photo: junction box → waterproof connector ≈ 4.2 m, of which the coil ≈ 3.8 m; connector → stripped end 0.41 m + 7–8 cm of bare cores; OD 4.1 mm). Cut the panel side at 200 mm and solder it to the 100 mm tail left on the connector side (2 joints + heat-shrink); cut the other side of the connector to 200 mm, strip and clamp into the terminal
Route: Panel back → channel T1 → back pod PANEL port (secured with a cable-tie bridge)

Name: battery
Conductors (colour · from → to): red · Battery + (after PCM) → J2-1 BAT+ | black · Battery − → J2-2 GND
Source: Battery's own PH2.0 plug (⚠ red wire to J2 silkscreen +)
Route: Inside pod: battery left end → over the divider → J2

Name: ntc
Conductors (colour · from → to): — · NTC 10 kΩ (non-polarised) → J3-1 NTC_ADC | — · NTC → J3-2 GND
Source: Ready-made NTC 10k B3950 with PH2.0 lead (purchased)
Route: NTC taped to the middle of the battery with high-temperature tape

Name: ref1
Conductors (colour · from → to): red · REF1 cell + → J7-1 REF1+ | black · REF1 cell − → J7-2 GND
Source: Panel-lead offcut (2-core Ø4.1) 0.45 m + 1 × BOM "PH2mm straight-pin pre-wired" plug, 2 solder joints + heat-shrink
Route: REF1 clip → panel left edge → channel T2 → REF1 port

Name: ref2
Conductors (colour · from → to): red · REF2 cell + → J8-1 REF2+ | black · REF2 cell − → J8-2 GND
Source: Panel-lead offcut 0.6 m + 1 × PH2 plug, 2 solder joints + heat-shrink
Route: Left-shoulder REF2 → back yoke → channel T3 → REF2 port

Name: J6_back_to_chest
Conductors (colour · from → to): red · PMB-H J6-1 VLOAD → LIB J1-1 VLOAD | black · J6-2 GND → J1-2 GND | yellow · J6-3 SYNC → J1-3 SYNC_IN | green · J6-4 unused (NC) → J1-4 spare (to TP5 only) | black/blue · J6-5 GND → J1-5 GND
Source: PH2.0 5P double-ended straight-through (pin 1 to pin 1) cable 0.7 m (purchased; route 531 mm, 0.6 m leaves no slack for bending); a 5P magnetic connector can be inserted in-line
Route: Back pod CHEST port → channel T4 (right waistline) → chest pod BACK UNIT port

Name: lib_to_core_bat
Conductors (colour · from → to): red · LIB J2-1 VBIT → Core B battery socket + | black · LIB J2-2 GND → Core B battery socket −
Source: BOM "PH2.0 jumper cable", double-ended 10 cm (⚠ red wire in the same position as on the original Core battery plug)
Route: Inside pod, passing over the Core

Name: sync_to_I1
Conductors (colour · from → to): — · LIB J3-1 SYNC_OUT → UC-E6 SIGNAL → Core B port I1 | — · LIB J3-2 GND → UC-E6 GND | — · (not connected) → UC-E6 VCC / REF cut short and insulated
Source: PLUX "UC-E6 to open-end" sensor cable with one end cut off (purchased) + PH2 pre-wired lead, crimped/soldered

Name: ecg_B_uce6

Source: 30 cm UC-E6 sensor cable supplied with the HeartBIT kit ECG sensor (there is also a 10 cm one — too short)

Name: TC2_airgap

Source: BOM "Type-K surface thermocouple", supplied with plug

Name: Bench supply replaces the panel
Conductors (colour · from → to): red → J1-1 PV_IN+; black → J1-2 PV_IN−
Source: Banana plug / crocodile clip → stripped wire
Route: 7.0 V, 1.0 A current limit. The board has reverse-polarity protection; a reversed connection will not damage it

Name: TC-01 power measurement (A or C)
Conductors (colour · from → to): Battery + → breadboard → multimeter mA range (in series) → breadboard → device +; − straight through
Source: 2 × BOM "PH2mm straight-pin pre-wired" leads + 1 straight-pin header on the breadboard + Dupont jumpers
Route: Not needed for B: U5 on PMB-H (INA226 0x42) already measures B's load current

Name: TC-02 panel I-V curve
Conductors (colour · from → to): Panel + → resistor → panel −; multimeter across the resistor reads voltage, I = V / R
Source: 5 W ceramic (cement) resistors 3.3/4.7/6.8/10/15/22/33/68/150 Ω (purchased); open circuit = Voc, short circuit = Isc (multimeter 10 A range)
Route: Panel on the test stand, REF1 in the same plane records irradiance, TC1 records backsheet temperature

Name: Charging / capacity
To connector: micro-USB on A and C; USB-C on XIAO
Conductors (colour · from → to): Through the BOM "multi-function USB tester" inserted in between
Source: Original cables
Route: A and C are charged only when not being worn; B has no USB (powered by the back unit)

Name: Data (bench)
Conductors (colour · from → to): A: pair with the Mac's built-in Bluetooth (Classic); B, C: BLE
Source: Wireless
Route: The USB Bluetooth dongle in the kit is not needed on a Mac
